The shed has a wide-span portal-frame steel structure with light grey or off-white colour-coated corrugated roofing panels and matching side wall cladding, a clear-span interior visible through a large open roller-shutter front bay, and a clean concrete apron in the foreground. The structure shows visible ridge, eave gutters, and evenly spaced windows along the side wall. Background is a clear blue sky with minimal surroundings to keep focus on the shed. Bright, even daylight lighting. Professional architectural photography style. No people, no vehicles, no text overlays. White 'IndiaMART AI' watermark text in a dark semi-transparent pill badge, 10–12px, 60–70% opacity, bottom-right corner.
